qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant North American natural gas transmission grid, but 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 6.5% falls far short of the 12% threshold due to rate-base regulation, massive asset intensity, and multi-billion-dollar project cost overruns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (gate_3b = N). TC Energy owns an irreplaceable transcontinental natural gas pipeline network, but its 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 6.5% fails the 12% hurdle. Returns are structurally suppressed by rate-base regulation, heavy capital intensity, and historical mega-project overruns.
qualitative.evidence: TC Energy operates a 93,000+ km natural gas pipeline network delivering >25% of continental gas demand, alongside Bruce Power. Despite regulated and take-or-pay revenues, capital efficiency is low: GAAP ROIC was 2.5% in FY22, 5.2% in FY23, 8.4% in FY24, and 7.8% in FY25 (median 6.5%). Long-term debt stands at CAD $57.5B against CAD $3.4B net income.
